name: Rocking Horse
description: A hand-carved wooden rocking horse with a real horsehair mane and a polished saddle. A workshop classic that has been made here for over a century.

name: Dinosaur Dig Kit
description: Chip a plaster block apart with a tiny hammer and brush to uncover a complete toy dinosaur skeleton. Budding palaeontologists love it.

name: Stegosaurus Soft Toy
description: An extremely huggable stegosaurus with felt plates down its back and embroidered eyes. Safe from birth.

name: Rocket Launch Playset
description: A countdown console with flashing lights and a spring-loaded rocket that really launches across the room. Includes two astronaut figures.

name: Solar System Puzzle
description: A hundred-piece circular jigsaw of the planets, with each world labelled and shown to scale against the sun.

name: Tyrannosaurus Floor Puzzle
description: A giant floor jigsaw that builds into a life-size baby T. rex, nearly a metre long when finished.

name: Snakes and Ladders
description: The old favourite, printed on a folding wooden board with chunky counters that small hands can hold.

name: Elf Express Train Set
description: A figure-of-eight wooden track with a magnetic engine, three carriages, a tunnel and a little station painted in workshop red and green.

name: Space Explorer Board Game
description: Race your crew between planets collecting fuel and samples. Takes about forty minutes and works well for two to four players.

name: Velociraptor Figure
description: A poseable velociraptor with jointed legs and a button in its back that produces a convincingly unpleasant screech.

name: Knitted Snowman
description: A soft knitted snowman with a stitched carrot nose and a stripy scarf. Machine washable, which parents appreciate.

name: Marble Run Starter Set
description: Forty beech blocks with channels and funnels, plus twenty glass marbles. Builds a different run every time.

name: Pocket Telescope
description: A small refracting telescope with a folding tripod, good enough to show the craters of the moon and the moons of Jupiter.

name: Finger Painting Set
description: Six pots of thick, bright, entirely washable paint with a pad of heavy paper. Aprons sold separately, and strongly recommended.

name: Triceratops Night Light
description: A frosted triceratops that glows a gentle amber and fades out over twenty minutes once the room goes quiet.

name: Wooden Tool Bench
description: A sturdy little workbench with a wooden saw, hammer, spanner and a rack of oversized nuts and bolts.

name: Constellation Projector
description: Throws the northern night sky across a bedroom ceiling and slowly rotates, with a disc for each season.

name: Memory Match Cards
description: Fifty-four illustrated cards in twenty-seven pairs, showing animals from every continent. Harder than it looks.

name: Brachiosaurus Balance Game
description: Stack wooden dinosaurs onto a wobbling brachiosaurus without bringing the whole herd down.

name: Kite, Red Dragon
description: A ripstop delta kite with a long red tail that flies happily in a light breeze. Line and winder included.

name: Beeswax Modelling Set
description: Twelve sheets of coloured beeswax that soften in warm hands and hold their shape without drying out or cracking.

name: Jigsaw: Santa's Workshop
description: Five hundred pieces of elves at work, with a hundred tiny details hidden in the background to find.

name: Skipping Rope, Wooden Handles
description: A cotton rope with turned beech handles and smooth bearings, adjustable for height.

name: Pterodactyl Glider
description: A balsa wood glider shaped like a pterosaur. Surprisingly good at finding thermals, and at landing on roofs.

name: Raptor Claw Torch
description: A moulded raptor claw that grips a bright little torch, for reading under the covers or inspecting the garden after dark.

name: Moon Lander Model Kit
description: Forty snap-together parts that build a lunar module with folding legs and a detachable ascent stage. No glue needed.

name: Woodland Animal Dominoes
description: Twenty-eight wooden dominoes printed with foxes, owls and hedgehogs instead of spots, so younger players can match pictures.

name: Clockwork Tin Robot
description: A lithographed tin robot that marches forward, strikes sparks behind its visor, and turns around when it meets a wall.

name: Ant Farm
description: A clear gel habitat that lets you watch tunnels appear day by day. Ants are not included, for reasons the elves consider obvious.

name: Quill and Ink Set
description: A real feather quill, two nibs and a pot of midnight-blue ink, for writing letters the proper way.

name: Lead Soldier Set
description: Thirty hand-painted soldiers in a wooden case. Withdrawn by the workshop on safety grounds and replaced by the pewter set.

name: Jack-in-the-Box, Original
description: The original spring-loaded design. Discontinued after the elves agreed it was a little too startling.

name: Magnetic Fishing Game
description: Twelve wooden fish with magnetic mouths and two bamboo rods. Being retired at the end of this season.

name: Glow Stars, Pack of 100
description: Self-adhesive glow-in-the-dark stars in four sizes. Discontinued once the constellation projector arrived.
